name: Joint Optimization with Loss Functions
aliases: Joint Optimization of Surfel Parameters and HDR Environment Map
definition: Joint optimization of surfel parameters (positions, tangents/quaternions, log-space scales, albedo, metallic, roughness) and a learnable HDR environment map using Adam optimizer.
summary: Joint optimization with loss functions simultaneously updates scene geometry, materials, and illumination by minimizing a composite objective, distinguishing itself by enforcing consistency across depth layers, surface normals, and image appearance.
